headline: Westlake 66 Mixed Use Complex / KPF
context: Westlake 66 is a new model for urban connectivity, landscape-driven design and computationally informed architecture, reinvigorating a deteriorated neighborhood and establishing a new civic heart in one of China's most dynamic cities.
